title: Gauss Agent Autoformalizes Viazovska’s 8D & 24D Sphere Packing Proofs in Lean 4
whyItMatters: Autoformalized Maryna Viazovska’s Fields Medal–winning 8D and 24D sphere packing proofs into ~200,000 lines of Lean 4, proving AI agents can formalize modern research-grade analysis.
summary: Following its September 2025 formalization of the Strong Prime Number Theorem, Math Inc.’s Gauss autoformalization agent—collaborating with Maryna Viazovska and formalization researchers—completed machine-checked Lean 4 proofs of optimal sphere packing in dimensions 8 and 24 (~200,000 lines of Lean). The milestone showed that deep modular-form and Fourier-analytic arguments could be translated into formal kernels at industrial speed.
technicalHighlights: Machine-checked Maryna Viazovska’s E8 (8D) and Leech lattice (24D) sphere packing theorems in ~200,000 lines of Lean 4.
Required formalizing extensive machinery in quasimodular forms, Poisson summation, and linear programming bounds.
Established autoformalization at 10⁵-line scale months before multi-million-line FLT and RH proofs.
caveats: Formalizes established 2016 human breakthroughs rather than proving a previously unknown theorem, though it dramatically expanded Mathlib-compatible analysis infrastructure.

scoreRationale.foundational: Landmark achievement in formalizing Fields-Medal-level analytic number theory and geometry.
scoreRationale.ripple: Directly accelerated large-scale Lean autoformalization pipelines used across 2026 mathematics.
scoreRationale.verification: Complete Lean 4 kernel verification documented with Viazovska and formalization specialists.
scoreRationale.velocity: Compressed multi-year projected human formalization timelines into weeks of agent execution.
